title: The Cost of Disruption
summary: It’s Friday, and stock traders once again would rather be holding long positions before the weekend. If the S&P 500 (SPX) can hold onto this morning’s gains, this would be the 11th Friday with a higher close of the 14 since the start of the third quarter.[i] Yesterday, we dipped on some inconvenient news reports about AI. Today, we’re getting a broader advance.
